notes.title: Demo v1.11Version update, optimized the room sorting algorithm & UI controller
notes.notes:
DISCORD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/fd05d6e236de396df2adc7cbc72fb12e5b253a5c.png
VERSION UPDATE
[olist]
 With the addition of UI controller, players can now enable or disable game-internal UI through the setting - screen - UI controller option.
 Changed the translation for the Full screen mode and other options.
 Players can now adjust the game resolution.
 We have fixed the bug where the "Water Park" would stuck.
 We have fixed the bug where the game would freeze during the " Catch the Penguin".
 We have fixed the bug where the game would freeze when entering certain rooms.
 We have optimized the room sorting algorithm.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/96366207446b90c27c19e8d7c599918de61d22f9.png
